work.summary: Digital MAXQ Secret B photobook featuring Korean fitness model and Pilates instructor Kim Dahye (김다혜). RIDI identifies a 42-page PDF e-book released 2023-07-28; MAXQ and Sports Seoul link the product's cover model to the Instagram account @dhyeello2 and her fitness content. The reviewed sources support a social-media creator identity but do not consistently use the formal label influencer. No ISBN was listed. Image overlap with other titles has not been checked; no cover or paid PDF was copied.

edition.contentSummary: RIDI identifies Secret B Vol. 13 as a 42-page, 8.0 MB PDF e-book published 2023-07-28 by MAXQ International. MAXQ's release story says the product became available on 2023-07-27; the RIDI date is stored and the one-day discrepancy is noted here. No ISBN was listed. No paid file or cover image was copied or mirrored.
